usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.audio.voice_consents.list(after="after", limit=20)
print(result)

fields.name: after
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 20.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `audio.voice_consent`.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The label provided when the consent recording was uploaded.

fields.name: language
fields.description: The BCP 47 language tag for the consent phrase (for example, `en-US`).

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the consent recording was created.
